senses.gloss: (a denom. of כֶּסֶל q. v.) [one with thick loins, stout,] (cmp. טִפֵּשׁ) fool, foolish, overbearing.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:18">Y. Peah I, 15ᵇ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 415:3">Yalk. Ex. 415</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 3:26">Prov. III, 26</cite>) <he>דברים שאתה כ׳ בהם וכ׳</he> in things in which thou art foolish (ignorant), He will guard thy foot &c.—Pl. <he>כְּסִילִים</he>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16:5">Num. R. s. 16</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 26:6">Prov. XXVI, 6</cite>) <he>עשו עצמן כ׳</he> they (the spies) made fools of themselves.

senses.gloss: K’sil, the constellation Orion (v. Winer, Reallex. s. v. Nimrod).
